verdict.rationale: Hightouch lets data engineers define models via SQL, dbt, or a visual builder (docs-2, docs-23), which supports filtering and transforming data before syncing to destinations, and CDC only sends changed rows (docs-25/36). However, there's no evidence of custom code/functions (e.g., JS/Python transform steps) applied in-pipeline for enrichment beyond SQL modeling, nor any dedicated transformation-step API distinct from model definition. Missing for 10: explicit custom-code/function transformation step, enrichment logic beyond SQL/dbt models, and independent verification of such capability.
